fields.description: The Canopies at Yas Point is a collection of 592 apartments across six midrise buildings on the northern shore of Yas Island. Gardens and a planned waterfront promenade connect the residential buildings, with homes ranging from studios to three-bedroom apartments.

sources.label: Aldar Canopies fact sheet, broker-linked copy

reviewCoverage.identity: 592 homes in six buildings, first release at Yas Point, established by Aldar launch announcement.
reviewCoverage.location: Northern shore of Yas Island confirmed by developer.
reviewCoverage.residences: Studio through three bedrooms; ancillary maid and study rooms not counted as half bedrooms.
reviewCoverage.areas: Fact sheet's overall range separated from broker-reported type averages; plan pack visually indexed.
reviewCoverage.amenities: Official launch and own brochure reviewed, with future promenade and retail clearly described as planned.
reviewCoverage.pricing: AED 1.65m launch reference from fact sheet, separate from later broker-selected inventory prices.
reviewCoverage.payment: 55/45 and 5% booking verified in fact sheet; no dated instalment calendar established.
reviewCoverage.handover: Fact sheet specifies 2030; Q3 comes from broker and remains attributed.
reviewCoverage.documents: Own 36-page brochure, 16-page floor plans and one-page fact sheet retrieved; fact-sheet pricing and area panels visually checked.

overview: The resident spaces balance outdoor recreation with quieter indoor uses. The brochure includes a coworking hub, a gym, an illuminated garden and places for yoga and outdoor cooking. Its materials palette describes porcelain flooring, laminate joinery and engineered-stone counters; the exact specification should be checked for the selected apartment.
research.locationNote: The Canopies occupies Yas Island's northern shore within Yas Point. Aldar describes a planned 700-metre waterfront promenade with retail, dining and public beach access. Delivery and access arrangements should be confirmed independently of the apartment handover.
research.priceNote: The reviewed fact sheet starts at AED 1.65m. This is a launch reference, not evidence that a home remains available at that price. Later broker selections may show higher entry prices for the units they advertise. Request a dated quotation and complete acquisition costs.
research.paymentNote: The fact sheet advertises 55% before handover, including 5% at booking, and 45% at handover. The stages below show that split only; a dated developer-issued instalment calendar was not established.
research.handoverNote: The fact sheet identifies 2030. DXB Residence reports Q3 2030, so the displayed quarter is a broker-reported estimate and must be confirmed against the selected unit's agreement.
